webdev.h1: Web Development Services for Fast, SEO-Ready Business Websites
webdev.lead: We design and develop high-performance websites and web apps focused on search visibility, conversion growth and stable Core Web Vitals.
webdev.p1: Corporate websites with multilingual structure and technical SEO.
webdev.p2: High-converting landing pages for paid and organic traffic.
webdev.p3: Web apps and portals with clean architecture and scalable delivery.
webdev.result: Our process is aimed at ranking growth, lower acquisition cost and stronger lead quality by combining technical SEO, content structure and UX clarity.

head.title: Web Development Services | SEO-ready websites and web apps | {{name}}
head.description: Web development agency delivering fast SEO-ready websites and web apps with technical SEO, multilingual support and strong Core Web Vitals.

optimization.h1: SEO Optimization Services for Sustainable Organic Growth
optimization.lead: We improve rankings and lead quality through technical SEO, structured content architecture and measurable on-page optimization.
optimization.p1: Technical audits: indexability, canonicals, sitemap, robots and schema.
optimization.p2: On-page improvements: title, metadata, heading hierarchy and internal linking.
optimization.p3: Performance optimization for stronger Core Web Vitals.
optimization.analytics: We align Search Console, GA4 and conversion tracking to connect rankings with real pipeline impact.

head.title: SEO Optimization Services | Technical and On-page SEO | {{name}}
head.description: Technical and on-page SEO services focused on indexability, Core Web Vitals, metadata quality and conversion-oriented organic traffic.

ecom.h1: E-commerce Development Services for Growth-Focused Stores
ecom.lead: We build ecommerce experiences on Shopify and custom stacks with high performance, SEO-ready category structure and conversion-driven UX.
ecom.p1: Product and category SEO architecture with scalable URL strategy.
ecom.p2: Checkout, payments and analytics integrations for clean attribution.
ecom.p3: Performance-first storefronts with optimized media and low JS overhead.
ecom.value: A technically strong ecommerce stack improves crawlability, product discoverability and conversion consistency across paid and organic channels.

head.title: E-commerce Development Services | Shopify and custom storefronts | {{name}}
head.description: E-commerce development for Shopify and custom storefronts with technical SEO, optimized checkout flows and Core Web Vitals performance.
